title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 00:00 UTC on 20 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 20 日 00:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 0.00 (label 0Z). Last-180-sample maximum is 2.00 (at 23:57 UTC on 19 September); published-window maximum is 2.00 (at 23:57 UTC). Hours through 17:00 UTC have rolled out of the public window; 18:00 UTC is partially rolled out (56 samples from 18:04). Completed bins 19:00–23:00 UTC closed at 1.33 / 1.67 / 0.00 / 1.00 / 1.67 respectively (19:00 peak 1.33 / 1P at 19:12, 60 samples; 20:00 peak 1.67 / 2M at 20:05, 60 samples; 21:00 peak 0.00 / 0Z, closed at 0.00 / 0Z, 60 samples; 22:00 peak 1.00 / 1Z at 22:43, 60 samples; 23:00 peak 2.00 / 2Z at 23:57, closed at 1.67 / 2M, 60 samples). 00:00 UTC bin is in progress (1 sample; 0.00 / 0Z at 00:00). estimated_kp remains below 5.0.

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute (00:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~357 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file. The in-progress 00:00 UTC hour currently has a single sample at 0.00 / 0Z and may be revised as NOAA updates.
